reviews.title: Broke what used to be a great app

Now I am limited to only twice a week for each exercise, including low intensity like yoga and stretching. AND I can no longer choose which days I get to do them. WHY would you break a great app for no apparent reason?! It no longer meets my needs at this point and I have cancelled the subscription.

reviews.title: Is this a scam?
reviews.text: I enrolled but over time forgot my password. In attempting to reset I used the website which recognized my email but informed to reset my password on the app.  When trying to reset on the app I am told my password is not recognized.  I've paid for the past 6 months and just notified that payment was made for another 3 months.  Despite writing for support several times I've still had no contact.  I'm beginning to suspect this app is a scam since it seems to me there is no customer service concern or care.  If I don't get a response in the next week I will be requesting intercession of my state's consumer Consumer Protection Agency, the FTC and Econsumer.gov.

I thought I’d canceled and, within minutes of the next charge hitting my credit card, I immediately contacted customer service for a refund and they said no and offered me a free year instead? reviews.title: Their cancellation policy is a rip-off.
reviews.text:
They get you out to their website to pay the subscription for two reasons:

1) to skirt Apple’s cut (don’t blame them there), and

2) to keep you paying as long as possible.

I reviewed my “active subscriptions” several weeks ago, and it was not among them. Then a few days ago I was hit with over $50 on my credit card. Of course I check Apple first, then in the app. Cancel my subscription and request a refund. They’ve gotten me for several billing cycles, and I’ve never used it. I’d cancelled and requested a refund within 2 hours of billing, but they say “sorry, no refund”. What a malignant way to do business. They just want to milk you for all they can get.

reviews.title: Still waiting….
reviews.text: I am confident this app content is helpful based on the reviews I see. My negative review has to do with how they conduct their business which I believe lacks customer responsiveness, integrity, and fairness.  I had a subscription that I did not use, and the renewals are on auto renewal. I received an email of my auto renewal, and immediately went to cancel the subscription, and following the process given to contact the app owners sent an email to their support as well as a message within the app requesting a refund of the money just charged me for the next three months of use, which I was not going to be using. I received an auto reply saying customer support was busy and would get back to me on my email, as well as a separate “sorry to see you go” message. I’ve seen no response to my request for a refund, and I’ve sent another message, and still 12 days later no response. Since this app is not through Apple, but directly with Fit Coach, you have no assistance with customer service nonresponsiveness, or issues with integrity of fair business practices. My lesson is you should be wary with allowing this Fit Coach business to process your money based on my experience.

reviews.title: Bait and switch! More money spent than just the promo
reviews.text:
This is a very difficult app to cancel. This is the second time that I tried to cancel this subscription from within the app. It automatically renews without any advice! 

 Bait and switch - you will pay more than the promo, as the app doesn’t let you cancel until after the promo expired and it renews at least once!!!!!! They say that all of the info is in their terms… BUT THESE TERMS DO NOT APPEAR UNTIL AFTER THE PAYMENT OF THE PROMO went through, AND CANCELLATION’s BUTTON IS GREYED OUT- so no cancellation until AFTER the second payment is extracted from you.

The phone number attached to this company never goes through. The support email did not answer when I stated that I had already canceled. 

 I will be complaining to Apple and any other service due to BAIT AND SWITCH MARKETING TACTICS. No way to contact customer service as of yet (more than 3 months). The excercises I purchased were supposed to be Pilates but they were exercises on a chair for a grandma. There were nothing like wall Pilates or barre ballet exercises. Again: The promo does NOT allow the CANCELLATION BUTTON to activate UNTIL THEY CHARGE THE ADDITIONAL 66.65 dollars!!!! Be AWERE!!! The app cancelation button DOES NOT WORK. Moreover: There is NO WAY this app has 4.7 stars without BOTS!!! I went one by one through all the reviews NOW! And 98% of the helpful reviews were ALL 1 stars!! This definitely needs to be reported up to Apple and Samsung companies to be deleted and investigated further.
